If Time Validation is enabled for a Time Base (refer to [ SWS_StbM_00464 ] and [ SWS_StbM_00465 ] ), upon invocation of StbM_<bus >SetSlaveTimingData() the StbM shall copy the content of the structure, which is passed by parameter measureDataPtr , to the next free <bus>SlaveTimingData block of the Time Slave Validation Record Table ( Table 2 ) of that Time Base.
